title: The Shrimp That Punches Like a Bullet 🦐 #shorts
description: The peacock mantis shrimp strikes at around 50 mph, creates collapsing vapor bubbles and sees with 12 types of color receptors.

scenes.text: This shrimp hits so hard, it has been known to crack aquarium glass.
Meet the peacock mantis shrimp. Its club-like arms strike at around fifty miles per hour.
The strike is so fast it rips the water apart into vapor bubbles. When they collapse, they hit the prey a second time.
And its eyes are just as extreme. It has twelve types of color receptors. Humans have three.
Follow for more animals you don't want to mess with.
